quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ
قَيِّمًۭا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا
مَّٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًۭا
وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا
مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا لِءَابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًۭا
فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا
وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا
أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا
فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًۭا
ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًۭا
نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَٰهُمْ هُدًۭى
وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهًۭا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًۭا شَطَطًا
هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍۢ ۖ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًۭا

۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّۭا مُّرْشِدًۭا

وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًۭا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌۭ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَٰسِطٌۭ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًۭا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًۭا

وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍۢ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا
إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا

وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَٰنًۭا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًۭا

سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَٰثَةٌۭ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌۭ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌۭ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءًۭ ظَٰهِرًۭا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا
وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌۭ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا
إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَٰذَا رَشَدًۭا
وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا۟ ۖ لَهُۥ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِۦ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
وَٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًۭا

وَٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًۭا

وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍۢ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًۭا مِّن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًۭا
۞ وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَحَفَفْنَٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍۢ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًۭا
كِلْتَا ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًۭا
وَكَانَ لَهُۥ ثَمَرٌۭ فَقَالَ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَنَا۠ أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًۭا
وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًۭا
وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًۭا
قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرْتَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًۭا
لَّٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا
وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًۭا
فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًۭا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًۭا زَلَقًا
أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًۭا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبًۭا
وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًۭا
وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٌۭ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
هُنَالِكَ ٱلْوَلَٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًۭا

وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًۭا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرًا
ٱلْمَالُ وَٱلْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًۭا
وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةًۭ وَحَشَرْنَٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًۭا
وَعُرِضُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّۭا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًۭا

وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًۭا

وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًۭا
۞ مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًۭا
وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا
وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًۭا
وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍۢ جَدَلًۭا
وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ قُبُلًۭا
وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُوا۟ هُزُوًۭا

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا
وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًۭا
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًۭا
وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًۭا
فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ سَرَبًۭا
فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًۭا
قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّى نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُۥ ۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًۭا
قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًۭا
فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًۭا
قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًۭا
قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًۭا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًۭا
قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًۭا
فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًۭا
قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًۭا
فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمًۭا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍۢ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًۭٔا نُّكْرًۭا
۞ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًۭا

فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًۭا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًۭا
قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا
وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا
فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا

وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌۭ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًۭا
وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا
فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًۭا ۗ قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًۭا
قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًۭا
ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًۭا
كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا
ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًۭا
قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًۭا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًۭا
فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا
قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّۭا
۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا
وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا
ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا
قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا
ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا
قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا

parent_channels.name: Straightened Transmission and Conduct

subchannels.name: An Unwarped Book Carries Warning and Promise
subchannels.scene_or_process: Revelation descends as an organized book whose semantic crookedness has been removed, allowing it to warn and announce recompense.
subchannels.active_motifs: organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; revelatory descent `ن ز ل:B002/m01`; semantic deviation `ع و ج:B002/m01`; upright equilibrium `ق و م:B008/m01`; caution-awakening warning `ن ذ ر:B001/m01`; joy-opening announcement `ب ش ر:B005/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; earned recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:1 (the descended book and denial of crookedness); 18:2 (upright warning, good news, good works, and reward)
subchannels.synthesis: The book is not merely called true. Its internal alignment is presented as the enabling condition for two directed effects: danger becomes legible, and faithful action receives a determinate outcome.

subchannels.name: Prepared Hearts Find the Sound Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: Petition, divine stabilization, proof, and guidance repeatedly convert vulnerable interior states into a practicable direction.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart-binding `ر ب ط:B004/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; unjust deviation `ش ط ط:B002/m01`; compelling proof `س ل ط:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:10 (prepared guidance); 18:14-15 (hearts bound against an outrageous claim and the demand for proof); 18:17 (divine guidance); 18:24 (hope for a nearer sound course)
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance here is engineered readiness rather than abstract information. The heart is held firm, an affair is made workable, and deviant speech is tested by whether it possesses compelling warrant.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A communication becomes trustworthy when deviation is removed from its form and its recipients are prepared to follow a sound course.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:1-2 presents an unwarped book, while 18:10 and 18:14-17, 18:24 distribute preparation, heart-binding, proof, and right guidance within the same pericope.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Straightness migrates from the shape of revelation into the posture of hearts and the practical route they seek.

parent_channels.name: Controlled Permeability at the Cave

subchannels.name: Withdrawal Opens an Interior Field of Mercy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separation from the surrounding people becomes movement into a refuge where mercy can spread and the difficult affair can be made serviceable.
subchannels.active_motifs: lateral withdrawal `ع ز ل:B001/m01`; joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`; broad cave `ك ه ف:B001/m01`; sheltering refuge `ك ه ف:B002/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; opening and spreading `ن ش ر:B001/m01`; usable facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:10 (taking refuge and asking for prepared guidance); 18:16 (withdrawal, entry into the cave, spreading mercy, and facilitating the affair)
subchannels.synthesis: Physical retreat is the first operation, not the final state. The enclosed place becomes productive because mercy is spread within it and the fugitives' affair is reorganized into a viable course.

subchannels.name: Light Passes Without Violating the Shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sun's approach and departure are spatially deflected so that illumination passes around occupants held in the cave's open interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; inclined deviation `ز و ر:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش م ل:B006/m01`; broad interior gap `ف ج و:B001/m01`; broad cave `ك ه ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:17 (sunrise, sunset, right and left passage, and the occupants in the cave's opening)
subchannels.synthesis: Protection is achieved through routing rather than total exclusion. The light remains active, but its trajectory is made compatible with the sleepers' preservation.

subchannels.name: The Threshold Converts Looking into Flight
subchannels.scene_or_process: The dog occupies the entrance while an approaching observer is allowed only a glimpse before terror reverses the approach.
subchannels.active_motifs: guarding dog `ك ل ب:B001/m01`; spatial extension `ب س ط:B001/m01`; outstretched forelimb `ب س ط:B004/m01`; arm-span `ذ ر ع:B001/m01`; forecourt threshold `و ص د:B002/m01`; peering access `ط ل ع:B003/m01`; turning away `و ل ي:B007/m01`; rapid flight `ف ر ر:B001/m01`; filling to capacity `م ل ء:B001/m01`; engulfing terror `ر ع ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:18 (the dog at the threshold, the observer's look, reversal, flight, and terror)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene gives the cave an active defensive edge. A stretched body marks the boundary, and attempted visual access triggers an immediate counter-movement away from it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Refuge works by regulating passage across a boundary: persons enter, mercy and light reach them selectively, and hostile access is repelled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:10, 18:16-18 repeatedly stage the cave as a threshold with differentiated inward and outward movement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cave is neither sealed nor simply open; it behaves as a selectively permeable shelter.

parent_channels.name: Suspension Turned into Measure

subchannels.name: Hearing Is Withheld While Bodies Remain
subchannels.scene_or_process: An imposed restraint reaches the ears, consciousness enters sleep, and bodies persist in a state that resembles wakefulness without ordinary reception.
subchannels.active_motifs: imposed restraint `ض ر ب:B004/m01`; ear as receptive opening `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; sleeping stillness `ر ق د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:11 (restraint upon the ears for numbered years); 18:18 (sleeping bodies appearing awake)
subchannels.synthesis: Suspension is organized through the sensory gate most closely tied to receiving a call. The bodies remain visibly present while the channel that would reconnect them to surrounding time is held closed.

subchannels.name: Awakening Makes Elapsed Time Countable
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sleepers are stirred so that competing estimates of their stay can expose who can count its furthest term.
subchannels.active_motifs: stirring from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`; temporal endpoint `ء م د:B001/m01`; extended stay `ل ب ث:B001/m01`; year-duration `س ن و:B008/m01`; nine-count `ت س ع:B001/m01`; three-count `ث ل ث:B001/m01`; hundred-count `م ء ي:B002/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:11-12 (numbered years, awakening, and comparison of duration); 18:19 (mutual questioning about the stay); 18:25 (three hundred years increased by nine)
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden interval is reconstructed through arithmetic and rival judgment. Counting is therefore not incidental chronology but the operation that makes suspended experience publicly contestable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A period of immobilized awareness becomes knowable only when awakening converts duration into comparison, number, and dispute.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:11-12, 18:18-19, and 18:25 place induced sleep, reanimation, and temporal reckoning in one pericope.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Awakening does not simply restore activity; it produces the epistemic problem by which hidden time can be measured.

parent_channels.name: Recovering Absence Through Durable Traces

subchannels.name: Inscription and Narrative Preserve the Vanished Scene
subchannels.scene_or_process: The departed youths persist through effects, inscription, signs, and a sequential retelling that makes their absence intelligible.
subchannels.active_motifs: lasting trace `ء ث ر:B003/m01`; inscribed record `ر ق م:B001/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; sequential narration `ق ص ص:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:6 (grief over their receding traces); 18:9 (the cave and the inscription among the signs); 18:13 (their account narrated in sequence)
subchannels.synthesis: The episode opens by treating disappearance as something that leaves readable residue. Record and narration stabilize what direct observation can no longer hold.

subchannels.name: Forgotten Loss Is Reversed by Following Its Track
subchannels.scene_or_process: A forgotten fish becomes locatable when recovered memory prompts a return along the travelers' own footprints to the point of escape.
subchannels.active_motifs: memory lapse `ن س ي:B001/m01`; recovered recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; return to a prior point `ر د د:B001/m01`; following a trace `ء ث ر:B004/m01`; stepwise tracking `ق ص ص:B001/m01`; directed seeking `ب غ ي:B001/m01`; extended path `س ب ل:B001/m01`; fish `ح و ت:B001/m01`; tunnel-like passage `س ر ب:B002/m01`; seeping aquatic passage `س ر ب:B003/m01`; open water `ب ح ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:61 (the forgotten fish takes its path into the sea); 18:62-63 (the loss and its cause are recalled); 18:64 (the travelers return by following their traces)
subchannels.synthesis: Retrieval begins only after forgetting itself becomes legible. Memory identifies the lost junction, and the visible route permits motion to be reversed with precision.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is no longer immediately present can be recovered when absence leaves an ordered mark that can be read backward.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 4 (18:60-82); bridge: the inscription and narrative traces of 18:6, 18:9, 18:13 and the retraced fish-path of 18:61-64 share a durable-mark retrieval operation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A written memorial and a fugitive path perform the same retrieval function at different scales.

parent_channels.name: Unsupported Speech as Physical Force

subchannels.name: An Unknown Claim Protrudes from the Mouth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim lacking knowledge is pictured as something large that crosses the mouth's boundary and enters the shared world.
subchannels.active_motifs: speaking mouth `ف و ه:B003/m01`; emergence from enclosure `خ ر ج:B001/m01`; connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; unsupported attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; fabricated falsehood `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:4-5 (the attributed son, absence of knowledge, and the enormity of the word leaving their mouths)
subchannels.synthesis: The utterance is judged through its origin and trajectory. Because no knowledge stands behind it, its emergence is a hazardous extrusion rather than responsible communication.

subchannels.name: Conjecture Stones What Cannot Be Seen
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rival number claims are thrown toward an unseen matter and are restrained by limited disputation and refusal to solicit further estimates.
subchannels.active_motifs: injurious verbal stoning `ر ج م:B002/m01`; conjectural stoning of the unseen `ر ج م:B004/m01`; hidden domain `غ ي ب:B001/m01`; sharpened disputation `م ر ي:B003/m01`; unsettled doubt `م ر ي:B004/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:22 (competing counts, stoning at the unseen, and restriction of dispute and inquiry)
subchannels.synthesis: Number does not become evidence merely by being asserted. The image of stoning exposes estimates as projectiles launched where sight and knowledge do not reach.

subchannels.name: Twisted Dispute Tries to Make Truth Lose Its Footing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeatedly varied signs meet a tightly wound argument whose purpose is to slide stable truth away and replace warning with mockery.
subchannels.active_motifs: rhetorical turning `ص ر ف:B002/m01`; struck comparison `م ث ل:B003/m01`; tightly twisted contest `ج د ل:B001/m01`; tangled disputation `ج د ل:B002/m01`; loss of stability `ب ط ل:B001/m01`; false claim `ب ط ل:B003/m01`; slippery footing `د ح ض:B001/m01`; collapsed argument `د ح ض:B003/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B001/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; derisive treatment `ه ز ء:B001/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; caution-awakening warning `ن ذ ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:54 (varied comparisons and human disputation); 18:55-56 (resistance to guidance and argument with falsehood to dislodge truth)
subchannels.synthesis: The contest is modeled as mechanics: signs are turned through multiple faces, objection is wound tight, and falsehood seeks to make truth slip. Mockery is the desired outcome of that displacement.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech detached from knowledge is rendered as a bodily or mechanical act that exits, strikes, twists, or removes footing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 3 (18:45-59); bridge: 18:4-5, 18:22, and 18:54-56 share the physicalization of unwarranted assertion as extrusion, projectile conjecture, and destabilizing contest.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The surah tests claims not only by truth value but by the kind of force their utterance applies.

parent_channels.name: Productive Surfaces Stripped of Support

subchannels.name: Adorned Earth Is Reduced to Bare Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earth is made attractive as a field of testing and then transformed into a cut-off, exposed surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile earth `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; revealing test `ب ل و:B002/m01`; cutting eradication `ج ر ز:B001/m01`; vegetation-stripped land `ج ر ز:B002/m01`; exposed ground `ص ع د:B004/m01`; transformation of condition `ج ع ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:7 (earth's adornment as a test); 18:8 (its reduction to barren exposed ground)
subchannels.synthesis: Beauty is explicitly temporary infrastructure for disclosure. Once the covering growth is cut away, the underlying surface reveals the nonpermanence of what had occupied it.

subchannels.name: Engineered Yield Collapses with Its Water System
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grapevines, palms, crops, trellises, and a channel produce without failure until encompassing loss collapses both yield and support while water becomes unreachable.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; grape yield `ع ن ب:B001/m01`; encircling border `ح ف ف:B001/m01`; palm cultivation `ن خ ل:B001/m01`; sown crop `ز ر ع:B001/m01`; productive yielding `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; edible yield `ء ك ل:B002/m01`; ripened fruit `ث م ر:B001/m01`; growing wealth `ث م ر:B002/m01`; bursting channel `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; flowing riverbed `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; vine trellis `ع ر ش:B003/m01`; sustaining water `م و ه:B001/m01`; sinking water `غ و ر:B001/m01`; inaccessible depth `غ و ر:B002/m01`; slick denuded soil `ز ل ق:B001/m01`; structural collapse `خ و ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:32-34 (garden layout, channel, unfailing produce, and wealth); 18:40-41 (slick ground or sunken water); 18:42 (produce encompassed and trellises collapsed)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene binds wealth to a hydraulic and structural system. Loss is complete because it attacks the conditions of fruitfulness, not just the fruit already visible.

subchannels.name: Rain-Grown Vegetation Becomes Windborne Fragments
subchannels.scene_or_process: Descending water mixes with earth and raises vegetation, after which drying and wind convert it into dispersed debris.
subchannels.active_motifs: descending rain `ن ز ل:B001/m01`; sustaining water `م و ه:B001/m01`; fertile earth `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; productive mixing `خ ل ط:B001/m01`; vegetative emergence `ن ب ت:B001/m01`; dry broken plant matter `ه ش م:B002/m01`; wind-winnowing `ذ ر و:B004/m01`; moving wind `ر و ح:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:45 (water descends, vegetation mixes and grows, then becomes dry material scattered by winds)
subchannels.synthesis: The parable compresses a full support cycle into one scene. Water first binds earth and plant into growth; wind later separates that union into fragments.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Display and yield depend on sustaining media; when water, structure, or rootedness is withdrawn, a productive surface becomes exposed, collapsed, or scattered.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), and 3 (18:45-59); bridge: 18:7-8, 18:32-42, and 18:45 share the same support-removal transformation across earth, garden infrastructure, and seasonal vegetation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The apparently separate images form a graded material sequence from denudation, through structural collapse, to airborne dispersal.

parent_channels.name: Resting Places and Reversed Hospitality

subchannels.name: Relief Requests Intensify the Hostile Enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire surrounds like a pavilion, and a request for drink is answered by a liquid whose heat attacks the face.
subchannels.active_motifs: burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; physical encirclement `ح و ط:B001/m01`; surrounding pavilion `س ر د ق:B001/m01`; appeal for relief `غ و ث:B001/m01`; offered liquid `م و ه:B001/m01`; molten dregs `م ه ل:B003/m01`; roasting heat `ش و ي:B001/m01`; drinking `ش ر ب:B001/m01`; hostile resting facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (the encircling pavilion of fire, plea for relief, scalding drink, and evil resting place)
subchannels.synthesis: Every ordinary sign of reception is inverted. Shelter confines, service answers distress with further injury, and the designated place of rest becomes part of the punishment.

subchannels.name: Adornment and Reclining Materialize a Good Rest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flowing gardens supply jewelry, clothing, and supported reclining as an embodied form of settled reward.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; flowing channel `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; jewelry `ح ل ي:B001/m01`; encircling bracelet `س و ر:B004/m01`; gold `ذ ه ب:B001/m01`; clothing as covering `ل ب س:B001/m01`; garment `ث و ب:B003/m01`; living green `خ ض ر:B001/m01`; supported reclining `و ك ء:B004/m01`; curtained couch `ء ر ك:B004/m01`; beneficial resting facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:31 (gardens and rivers, gold bracelets, green garments, and reclining on couches)
subchannels.synthesis: Reward is not left as an abstraction. It is assembled from stable supports around the body: channel, garment, ornament, couch, and an explicitly good place to settle.

subchannels.name: Hell Is Prepared as Lodging for Misplaced Allegiance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those who replace the proper protector with created allies encounter a destination already made ready as their reception.
subchannels.active_motifs: prepared readiness `ع ت د:B001/m01`; guest provision and lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; adopted ally `و ل ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:102 (created servants taken as allies and Hell prepared as lodging)
subchannels.synthesis: The destination answers a prior error in hosting and allegiance. Those treated as protective hosts cannot receive their dependents, while the rejected destination is already prepared to do so.

subchannels.name: Paradise Receives Without Requiring Departure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound action is received in the gardens of Firdaus as prepared lodging whose residents neither leave nor seek transfer.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; guest provision and lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`; abiding residence `خ ل د:B001/m01`; directed desire `ب غ ي:B001/m01`; change of place or state `ح و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:107 (belief, sound action, gardens, and prepared lodging); 18:108 (abiding and no desire for transfer)
subchannels.synthesis: The good lodging resolves movement rather than merely interrupting it. Its adequacy is shown by the disappearance of any need to seek another place.

subchannels.name: A Usable Refuge Prefigures the Resting-Place Contrast
subchannels.scene_or_process: The cave affair is first supplied with a beneficial facility, after which the same resting-place sense evaluates the fiery enclosure and the reclining garden in opposite directions.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; opening and spreading `ن ش ر:B001/m01`; usable facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`; burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; enclosed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:16 (mercy spread and the affair furnished with a useful facility); 18:29 (evil resting facility); 18:31 (good resting facility)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical recurrence makes the cave more than a hiding place. It establishes a functional measure for later destinations: a place is judged by whether its arrangement actually serves those received into it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Refuge and final states are staged as prepared reception, with facility, enclosure, drink, clothing, seating, and residence defining whether reception protects, torments, or gives rest.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: the usable facility prepared in 18:16 becomes the explicitly bad or good resting facility of 18:29, 18:31, while 18:102 and 18:107 name Hell and Paradise as prepared guest-lodging.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cave, punishment, and reward share a hospitality grammar whose provisions are morally differentiated.

parent_channels.name: Supports That Fail Under Demand

subchannels.name: Accumulated Wealth Cannot Produce a Rescuing Group
subchannels.scene_or_process: Quantity and social dominance generate a forecast of permanence, but the collapse leaves neither a supporting faction nor self-rescue.
subchannels.active_motifs: accumulated wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; numerical increase `ك ث ر:B001/m01`; boastful superiority by quantity `ك ث ر:B002/m01`; status-power `ع ز ز:B001/m01`; social dominance `ع ز ز:B002/m01`; supporting retinue `ن ف ر:B003/m01`; offspring `و ل د:B001/m01`; unsupported conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; imagined permanence `ء ب د:B001/m01`; separate support group `ف ء ي:B003/m01`; effective aid `ن ص ر:B001/m01`; governing support `و ل ي:B003/m01`; exposed outcome `ع ق ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:34-36 (wealth, retinue, superiority, and presumed permanence); 18:39 (wealth and offspring as the basis of comparison); 18:42-44 (loss, no rescuing group, no self-help, and the true locus of protection)
subchannels.synthesis: The owner's error is functional: he mistakes possession for a system capable of answering catastrophe. Once the garden falls, every supposed reinforcement is revealed as descriptive status rather than operative help.

subchannels.name: Chosen Allies Cannot Witness, Answer, or Open an Exit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Adopted allies are denied participation in creation, fail to answer a summons, and leave their claimants caught behind an obstructing separation.
subchannels.active_motifs: adopted dependence `ء خ ذ:B010/m01`; chosen ally `و ل ي:B004/m01`; adversarial relation `ع د و:B003/m01`; failed substitute `ب د ل:B001/m01`; witnessing presence `ش ه د:B001/m01`; strengthening arm `ع ض د:B002/m01`; claimed partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; idolatrous association `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; uncertain assertion `ز ع م:B001/m01`; summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; responsive answer `ج و ب:B003/m01`; obstructing barrier `و ب ق:B001/m01`; inescapable entrapment `و ب ق:B003/m01`; route of diversion `ص ر ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:50-51 (allies adopted despite enmity, absent from creation and unusable as strengthening arms); 18:52-53 (summons without answer, barrier, and no route away from the fire)
subchannels.synthesis: The alliance claim is subjected to successive operational checks. It fails at origin, witness, reinforcement, response, and finally escape.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A claimed source of strength is exposed as false when crisis demands actual rescue, testimony, response, or escape.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 2 (18:27-44) and 3 (18:45-59); bridge: the wealth complex of 18:34-44 and the alliance complex of 18:50-53 are tested by the same failed-support operation: neither can rescue, answer, reinforce, or open an exit under demand.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Property, descendants, retinue, and supernatural allies are treated as interchangeable support claims and judged by the same performance test.

parent_channels.name: Action Made Material for Reckoning

subchannels.name: The Placed Record Makes Every Act Present
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written record is set in view, prompting fearful recognition that no small or large action has escaped exhaustive enumeration.
subchannels.active_motifs: placement in view `و ض ع:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; fixed record `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; criminal liability `ج ر م:B004/m01`; fearful concern `ش ف ق:B003/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; confronting what is found `و ج د:B001/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:49 (the record placed, alarm at its exhaustive count, and all deeds found present)
subchannels.synthesis: The record abolishes the distance between doing and consequence. Scale does not matter to inclusion: every act reappears as a present item before judgment.

subchannels.name: Misjudged Craft Arrives Without Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: People expend effort and refine production while supposing it good, yet the work is lost and receives no valuation at the final weighing.
subchannels.active_motifs: diminishing loss `خ س ر:B001/m01`; failed exchange `خ س ر:B002/m01`; lost course `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; erased trace of work `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; laboring pursuit `س ع ي:B002/m01`; mistaken estimation `ح س ب:B002/m01`; presumed excellence `ح س ن:B002/m01`; making `ص ن ع:B001/m01`; skilled craft `ص ن ع:B002/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; valuation `ق و م:B010/m01`; weighing `و ز ن:B001/m01`; accounting scale `و ز ن:B002/m01`; recognized weight `و ز ن:B007/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:103-104 (the greatest losers, whose labor is lost while they suppose they craft well); 18:105 (rejection of signs and encounter, followed by absence of weight)
subchannels.synthesis: Effort, technique, and self-assessment cannot establish value by themselves. Reckoning translates production into weight, exposing the possibility that an elaborate work has no standing in the relevant measure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human activity is externalized into an object that can be placed, counted, found, valued, or denied weight.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 3 (18:45-59) and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: the record of 18:49 and the scale language of 18:103-105 share a material-accounting operation that converts lived action into assessable presence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The gravest failure is not inactivity but labor whose apparent craft cannot survive translation into weight.

parent_channels.name: Occluded Reception

subchannels.name: Self-Produced Neglect Hardens into Covered Hearts and Heavy Ears
subchannels.scene_or_process: Turning from reminder and neglecting prior deeds culminate in covers over hearts and weight in ears, so renewed calls cannot yield guidance.
subchannels.active_motifs: received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; lateral turning `ع ر ض:B005/m01`; deliberate neglect `ن س ي:B002/m01`; sending deeds ahead `ق د م:B004/m01`; hand-produced consequence `ي د ي:B009/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`; receptive ear `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (turning from reminder, forgetting what the hands sent ahead, heart covers, ear weight, and futile call to guidance)
subchannels.synthesis: Occlusion has a moral history. The bodily barriers manifest an earlier sequence of turning and neglect, after which additional address encounters a receiver no longer able to process it.

subchannels.name: Covered Sight Is Paired with Incapable Hearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Eyes remain under a covering that excludes reminder while hearing is described as beyond their capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual organ `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; visual covering `غ ط و:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; operative capacity `ط و ع:B003/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:101 (eyes covered from reminder and inability to hear)
subchannels.synthesis: The closing scene compresses rejection into coordinated sensory failure. What should be seen and heard is present, but both routes of reception are disabled.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Rejection is enacted by layers over organs of reception, preventing reminder from becoming understanding, sight, or hearing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 3 (18:45-59) and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: 18:57 covers hearts and weights ears, while 18:101 covers eyes and negates the capacity to hear.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The obstacle is portrayed less as missing information than as an architecture that prevents information from entering.

parent_channels.name: Mercy as Deferred Seizure

subchannels.name: Accountability Is Held Back Until an Appointed Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: A merciful and forgiving Lord could seize people for what they earn but instead withholds acceleration and assigns a time with no refuge beyond it.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective forgiveness `غ ف ر:B002/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; accountable seizure `ء خ ذ:B002/m01`; acquired deed `ك س ب:B001/m01`; premature acceleration `ع ج ل:B001/m01`; punitive consequence `ع ذ ب:B005/m01`; appointed boundary `و ع د:B003/m01`; refuge from consequence `و ء ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:58 (forgiveness and mercy, deserved seizure, punishment not hastened, appointed time, and no refuge)
subchannels.synthesis: Delay is neither indifference nor uncertainty. It is a governed interval between earning and seizure, terminated by a fixed appointment.

subchannels.name: Communal Ruin Also Waits on a Fixed Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wrongdoing communities are destroyed only in relation to an assigned time of destruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled community `ق ر ي:B001/m01`; destructive ending `ه ل ك:B001/m01`; wrongful displacement `ظ ل م:B003/m01`; appointed boundary `و ع د:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:59 (the towns, their wrongdoing, destruction, and its appointed time)
subchannels.synthesis: The temporal rule extends from individual accountability to collective history. A community can cross the moral condition for ruin before the set time permits ruin to arrive.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Mercy appears temporally as the refusal to let deserved consequence arrive at once, while still fixing a boundary beyond which it will not recede.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:58 states delayed punishment and an appointed time, and 18:59 applies an appointed limit to destroyed communities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Forgiveness is rendered as control of the clock of seizure rather than cancellation of moral consequence.

parent_channels.name: Protective Subtraction

subchannels.name: A Small Defect Blocks Total Confiscation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A working vessel is punctured so that its visible defect can keep a predatory king from seizing it whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: water-cutting vessel `س ف ن:B003/m01`; scraped surface `س ف ن:B001/m01`; boarding `ر ك ب:B001/m01`; deliberate puncture `خ ر ق:B001/m01`; threatened drowning `غ ر ق:B001/m01`; disabling defect `ع ي ب:B001/m01`; coercive ruler `م ل ك:B003/m01`; physical taking `ء خ ذ:B001/m01`; forcible confiscation `غ ص ب:B001/m01`; vulnerable poverty `س ك ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:71 (boarding and puncturing the ship); 18:79 (the vulnerable workers, defective vessel, and king seizing every sound ship)
subchannels.synthesis: The puncture subtracts exchange value while preserving use value. A bounded impairment protects both vessel and workers from an unbounded act of appropriation.

subchannels.name: Removal Makes Space for a Less Overwhelming Kinship
subchannels.scene_or_process: A seemingly pure child is killed because the anticipated relation would overburden faithful parents, and replacement is directed toward greater purity, tenderness, and nearness.
subchannels.active_motifs: dependent youth `غ ل م:B001/m01`; lethal removal `ق ت ل:B001/m01`; inviolable person `ن ف س:B011/m01`; purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; parental nurture `ء ب و:B001/m01`; anticipatory fear `خ ش ي:B001/m01`; coercive overwhelming `ر ه ق:B001/m01`; unbearable burden `ر ه ق:B003/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; replacement `ب د ل:B001/m01`; comparative good `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; kinship-nearness `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; womb-tenderness `ر ح م:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:74 (the youth and lethal act); 18:80-81 (the parents, feared overwhelming rebellion, and replacement with one purer and nearer in tenderness)
subchannels.synthesis: The explanation shifts evaluation from the removed individual to a forecast relation. The subtraction prevents one future from engulfing the parents and opens a different line of kinship.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A controlled local loss prevents a more comprehensive seizure or corruption from overwhelming vulnerable dependents.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:71, 18:74, and their explanations in 18:79-81 form two deliberate subtraction scenes within the fourth pericope.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Damage and replacement are evaluated by the relation they preserve, not by the isolated object removed.

parent_channels.name: Barriers That Hold Until a Threshold

subchannels.name: The Straightened Wall Holds an Inheritance Until Maturity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A failing wall is restored because it covers a treasure belonging to orphans who must reach full strength before extracting it.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised wall `ج د ر:B001/m01`; restored standing `ق و م:B002/m01`; structural straightening `ق و م:B008/m01`; orphaned dependence `ي ت م:B001/m01`; buried treasure `ك ن ز:B001/m01`; paternal provision `ء ب و:B001/m01`; inherited soundness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; arrival at an endpoint `ب ل غ:B001/m01`; attained maturity `ش د د:B004/m01`; extraction from enclosure `خ ر ج:B001/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:77 (the wall about to fall and its restoration); 18:82 (orphans, treasure, righteous father, maturity, extraction, and mercy)
subchannels.synthesis: Straightening the wall preserves concealment. Its success consists in preventing present access until the intended beneficiaries are strong enough to open what it guards.

subchannels.name: A Fused Rampart Holds a Breach Until the Promise
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gap between mountain sides is filled with iron masses and poured metal, blocking both climbing and piercing until the appointed promise levels it.
subchannels.active_motifs: interval between sides `ب ي ن:B002/m01`; gap-closing barrier `س د د:B001/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`; established capacity `م ك ن:B005/m01`; cooperative aid `ع و ن:B001/m01`; bundled strength `ق و ي:B001/m01`; iron masses `ز ب ر:B002/m01`; iron material `ح د د:B004/m01`; aligned faces `س و ي:B001/m01`; mountain side `ص د ف:B003/m01`; forceful blowing `ن ف خ:B001/m01`; heating fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; molten pouring `ف ر غ:B002/m01`; molten copper `ق ط ر:B006/m01`; attempted ascent `ظ ه ر:B007/m01`; piercing breach `ن ق ب:B001/m01`; crushing levelness `د ك ك:B001/m01`; appointed promise `و ع د:B003/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:93-96 (the interval, requested barrier, cooperative labor, iron, fire, and poured copper); 18:97 (neither climbed nor pierced); 18:98 (mercy, promise, and leveling)
subchannels.synthesis: The structure closes two modes of unauthorized passage and converts distributed material and labor into temporary protection. Its eventual flattening is part of its design horizon, not a retrospective failure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A vertical structure protects what lies behind or beneath it by delaying access until a divinely bounded transition.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 4 (18:60-82) and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: the repaired wall of 18:77, 18:82 and the fused rampart of 18:93-98 both defer premature access, one until maturity and the other until the promise arrives.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Repair and monumental construction converge as temporary custodians rather than permanent monuments.

parent_channels.name: Governed Reach Along Connective Means

subchannels.name: Connection Becomes a Route Only When Followed
subchannels.scene_or_process: Endowed power and supplied means are repeatedly activated through following until successive geographic endpoints and an interval between barriers are reached.
subchannels.active_motifs: established capacity `م ك ن:B005/m01`; supplied means `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; rope-like connection `س ب ب:B003/m01`; disciplined following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; arrival at an endpoint `ب ل غ:B001/m01`; interval between sides `ب ي ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:84-85 (capacity, a means for every matter, and following a means); 18:89-92 (repeated following); 18:93 (arrival between the two barriers)
subchannels.synthesis: A means is neither the destination nor mere equipment. It is a connective possibility whose value appears only through sustained traversal to an actual limit.

subchannels.name: Boundary Conditions Determine the Form of Rule
subchannels.scene_or_process: At western and eastern limits, distinct environmental exposure and moral condition call forth punishment, good treatment, easy command, or informed restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; spring source `ع ي ن:B006/m01`; dark mud `ح م ء:B001/m01`; protective covering `س ت ر:B001/m01`; encountered people `ق و م:B001/m01`; punitive consequence `ع ذ ب:B005/m01`; adopted course of treatment `ء خ ذ:B010/m01`; beneficial excellence `ح س ن:B002/m01`; proportionate recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; ease of command `ي س ر:B001/m01`; encompassing knowledge `ح و ط:B004/m01`; inner acquaintance `خ ب ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:86-88 (western limit, its people, choice of punishment or good treatment, and differentiated recompense); 18:90-91 (eastern exposure without covering and knowledge encompassing their condition)
subchannels.synthesis: Reach does not authorize a uniform response. The ruler reads both moral conduct and material exposure, then fits action and speech to what the boundary reveals.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Granted capacity becomes just rule only by following available connections to their limits and calibrating action to the conditions encountered there.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 18:84-93 repeatedly joins established power, supplied means, following, arrival at boundaries, and differentiated treatment within the fifth pericope.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sovereignty is pictured as disciplined traversal and local adjustment rather than possession of a static center.

parent_channels.name: Remembrance Reopens a Route While Neglect Seals It

subchannels.name: Recollection Restores Direction and Retraces the Lost Junction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Remembering after a lapse first reorients future intention toward a sound course, then physically reverses a journey to the point where the lost sign escaped.
subchannels.active_motifs: recoverable lapse `ن س ي:B001/m01`; recovered recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; return to a prior point `ر د د:B001/m01`; following a trace `ء ث ر:B004/m01`; stepwise tracking `ق ص ص:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:24 (remembering the Lord after forgetting and seeking a sounder course); 18:61-64 (forgotten fish, recovered memory, return, and retracing)
subchannels.synthesis: In both pericopes, remembrance has a directional effect. It does not merely restore a mental item; it corrects the next act and makes a previously missed route available again.

subchannels.name: Neglected Reminder Becomes a Closed Sensory System
subchannels.scene_or_process: Treating prior deeds and reminder as things to leave behind culminates in covered hearts, weighted ears, covered eyes, and incapacity to hear.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate neglect `ن س ي:B002/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; lateral turning `ع ر ض:B005/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; visual covering `غ ط و:B001/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (turning, neglect, heart covers, and ear weight); 18:101 (eyes covered from reminder and inability to hear)
subchannels.synthesis: Neglect reverses the restorative sequence. Instead of memory reopening a path to what was missed, repeated exclusion builds a receiver in which reminder can no longer arrive as actionable knowledge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A lapse remains reversible when recollection redirects action, but deliberate neglect converts the absent reminder into a durable closure of reception.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 3 (18:45-59), 4 (18:60-82), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: the same forgetting-remembrance relation produces opposite scene signatures, recovered motion in 18:24, 18:61-64 and sensory occlusion in 18:57, 18:101.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Forgetting is classified by its sequel rather than by the lapse alone: return distinguishes recoverable absence from entrenched abandonment.

parent_channels.name: Mercy Regulates Exposure Across Time

subchannels.name: Mercy Spreads Inside a Prepared Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Withdrawal into the cave places the youths where mercy can be spread and their exposed affair reorganized into a serviceable course.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`; sheltering cave `ك ه ف:B002/m01`; opening and spreading `ن ش ر:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; usable facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:10 (refuge, mercy, and prepared guidance); 18:16 (withdrawal, spread mercy, and facilitated affair)
subchannels.synthesis: Mercy first changes the occupants' exposure by relocating them and then changes the interior conditions of that relocation. Shelter and preparation operate together.

subchannels.name: Mercy Holds Seizure Behind an Appointed Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: Earned consequence could arrive immediately, but forgiving mercy prevents acceleration while preserving a fixed time of accountability.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; protective forgiveness `غ ف ر:B002/m01`; accountable seizure `ء خ ذ:B002/m01`; premature acceleration `ع ج ل:B001/m01`; appointed boundary `و ع د:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:58 (mercy and forgiveness, deserved seizure, delay, and the appointed time)
subchannels.synthesis: The danger is not removed from the moral horizon. Mercy changes the temporal relation to it, creating an interval before a boundary that remains real.

subchannels.name: Mercy Supplies the Interpreter of Protective Interventions
subchannels.scene_or_process: A servant given mercy and knowledge later discloses how defect, removal, replacement, and repair prevented confiscation, overwhelming, or premature extraction.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; disclosed outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`; forcible confiscation `غ ص ب:B001/m01`; coercive overwhelming `ر ه ق:B001/m01`; arrival at maturity `ب ل غ:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:65 (the servant given mercy and knowledge); 18:79-82 (confiscation, feared overwhelming, maturity, disclosed outcomes, and mercy)
subchannels.synthesis: Mercy governs both the interventions and their delayed intelligibility. The learner encounters local loss first and receives the protective causal account only after the sequence is complete.

subchannels.name: Mercy Holds a Breach Until the Promise Arrives
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fused barrier prevents ascent and piercing, but its protective interval ends when the divine promise levels it.
subchannels.active_motifs: tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; gap-closing barrier `س د د:B001/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`; piercing breach `ن ق ب:B001/m01`; appointed promise `و ع د:B003/m01`; crushing levelness `د ك ك:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:93-97 (the breach, constructed barrier, and blocked passage); 18:98 (mercy, promise, and leveling)
subchannels.synthesis: The rampart is merciful precisely as a time-bounded protection. Its eventual removal does not negate its role; it identifies the interval for which that role was intended.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Mercy protects by controlling when and how vulnerable beings meet danger, consequence, explanation, or access.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 3 (18:45-59), 4 (18:60-82), and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: repeated mercy language advances through shelter, delayed seizure, causally disclosed intervention, and a barrier held until an appointed promise.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mercy is repeatedly materialized as timing and arrangement, not only as an affective disposition.

parent_channels.name: Speech Is Licensed by Source and Sequence

subchannels.name: Hidden Matters and Future Acts Limit Assertion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Claims about divine kinship and unseen counts fail for lack of knowledge, while future-directed speech is redirected through remembered dependence.
subchannels.active_motifs: unsupported attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; conjectural stoning of the unseen `ر ج م:B004/m01`; hidden domain `غ ي ب:B001/m01`; sharpened disputation `م ر ي:B003/m01`; recovered recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:4-5 (claim without knowledge); 18:22 (unseen count, constrained dispute, and inquiry); 18:23-24 (future assertion qualified by remembered dependence)
subchannels.synthesis: The pericope distinguishes speaking from warrant. Neither confidence, numerical form, nor temporal intention can substitute for access to what the claim concerns.

subchannels.name: Questions Wait Until the Informed Guide Reports
subchannels.scene_or_process: The learner's questions are deferred until the guide initiates a report capable of disclosing the hidden outcome of each event.
subchannels.active_motifs: directed question `س ء ل:B001/m01`; narrated report `ح د ث:B003/m01`; self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; encompassing knowledge `ح و ط:B004/m01`; inner acquaintance `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; disclosed outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`; recovered reminder `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:67-70 (impatience, incomplete knowledge, and deferred questioning); 18:78, 18:82 (initiated interpretation and final disclosure)
subchannels.synthesis: Inquiry is not rejected as such. Its validity depends on sequence: observation precedes explanation, and explanation belongs first to the participant who knows the causal frame.

subchannels.name: Unalterable and Inexhaustible Words Ground Finite Human Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Divine words admit no substitute and exceed every material writing supply, while the human messenger speaks from a bounded position explicitly supplied by revelation.
subchannels.active_motifs: connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; individuated words `ك ل م:B002/m01`; impossible substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; written book `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; ink-feeding reservoir `م د د:B005/m01`; complete exhaustion `ن ف د:B001/m01`; received revelation `و ح ي:B004/m01`; indivisible oneness `و ح د:B004/m01`; human embodiment `ب ش ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:27 (revealed book and no substitute for divine words); 18:109 (finite ink and inexhaustible words); 18:110 (human messenger, received revelation, and one God)
subchannels.synthesis: The source problem is resolved through asymmetry. Human speech remains finite and embodied, but it can responsibly communicate what cannot be altered or exhausted when it presents itself as received rather than self-originating.

subchannels.name: Recitation Carries Received Material into a New Scene
subchannels.scene_or_process: A command to recite the revealed book is echoed when a requested account is promised as a recited reminder.
subchannels.active_motifs: sequential recitation `ت ل و:B001/m01`; received revelation `و ح ي:B004/m01`; written book `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; directed question `س ء ل:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:27 (recitation of what was revealed from the book); 18:83 (question about the two-horned ruler and promise to recite a reminder)
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation is a transmission operation rather than spontaneous authorship. It carries material already received or warranted into the audience's present question.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An utterance becomes responsible only when its speaker possesses the relevant access and observes the proper time for assertion, question, or disclosure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 4 (18:60-82), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: speaker roles progress from unsupported declarants, through a learner whose questions are sequenced, to recited reports and a messenger whose speech is explicitly received by revelation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Restraint does not terminate speech; it assigns each kind of speech to a warranted source and moment.

parent_channels.name: Boundaries Are Judged by the Traffic They Control

subchannels.name: Selective Boundaries Preserve Without Permanently Sealing
subchannels.scene_or_process: The cave routes light and repels intrusion, the repaired wall delays extraction until maturity, and the rampart blocks passage until the promise.
subchannels.active_motifs: sheltering cave `ك ه ف:B002/m01`; forecourt threshold `و ص د:B002/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; raised wall `ج د ر:B001/m01`; arrival at an endpoint `ب ل غ:B001/m01`; gap-closing barrier `س د د:B001/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`; piercing breach `ن ق ب:B001/m01`; appointed promise `و ع د:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:16-18 (cave refuge, routed light, threshold, and repelled observer); 18:77, 18:82 (wall, treasure, and maturity); 18:93-98 (barrier, blocked passage, and promised leveling)
subchannels.synthesis: These structures regulate access for a purpose and a term. They admit sustaining influence or intended beneficiaries while excluding intrusion, predation, and premature opening.

subchannels.name: A Protective Form Is Reversed into Cognitive Closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covers that would ordinarily preserve an interior instead preserve it from reminder, pairing heart and eye closure with blocked hearing.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; visual covering `غ ط و:B001/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (heart covers, ear weight, and failed understanding); 18:101 (covered eyes and inability to hear)
subchannels.synthesis: The geometry resembles protection, but its object is inverted. The barrier now keeps corrective address outside, turning preservation into epistemic loss.

subchannels.name: Punitive Enclosure Blocks Relief, Response, and Escape
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire surrounds like a pavilion, false allies remain across an obstructing separation without answering, and Hell stands prepared as final lodging.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical encirclement `ح و ط:B001/m01`; surrounding pavilion `س ر د ق:B001/m01`; appeal for relief `غ و ث:B001/m01`; obstructing barrier `و ب ق:B001/m01`; inescapable entrapment `و ب ق:B003/m01`; responsive answer `ج و ب:B003/m01`; route of diversion `ص ر ف:B001/m01`; prepared lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (encircling fire and failed relief); 18:52-53 (unanswered summons, barrier, and no diversion); 18:102 (Hell prepared as lodging)
subchannels.synthesis: Unlike protective boundaries, this enclosure is hostile because every desired crossing fails. Aid does not enter, allies do not answer across the separation, and occupants do not find a route out.

subchannels.name: Closing the Ear Preserves Sleep but Can Also Seal Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: The same sensory gate is divinely restrained to preserve sleepers, then morally weighted until guidance cannot enter, and finally paired with complete inability to hear.
subchannels.active_motifs: ear as receptive opening `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; imposed restraint `ض ر ب:B004/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; auditory reception `س م ع:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:11 (restraint upon the sleepers' ears); 18:57 (weight in ears blocks guidance); 18:101 (inability to hear)
subchannels.synthesis: Closure has opposite value according to purpose and agency. Temporary restraint protects a vulnerable state, whereas acquired heaviness preserves the hearer from the very address that could restore direction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Thresholds, covers, walls, and enclosures take their moral polarity from what they admit, preserve, obstruct, or trap.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), 4 (18:60-82), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: a repeated access-control scene signature is reversed across selective refuge, cognitive closure, and punitive confinement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The whole-surah pattern places physical architecture and sensory reception under one functional test without erasing their distinct scenes.

parent_channels.name: Sound Action Outlasts Adornment and Transfers Benefit

subchannels.name: Earthly Adornment Is Installed as a Test of Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: The earth's displayed beauty is made into an instrument for revealing which actors produce the better deed.
subchannels.active_motifs: displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; revealing test `ب ل و:B002/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; beneficial excellence `ح س ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:7 (earthly adornment, testing, and comparison of action)
subchannels.synthesis: Adornment has no independent verdict. Its function is to elicit conduct whose quality can be distinguished after the display itself is removed.

subchannels.name: The Gaze Must Not Trade Enduring Company for Display
subchannels.scene_or_process: Self and eyes are held with a devotional company while worldly adornment, desire, and excess pull attention beyond that relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; directed eye `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; near worldly life `د ن و:B002/m01`; desire's inclination `ه و ي:B004/m01`; excess beyond measure `ف ر ط:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:28 (restrained company, bounded gaze, worldly adornment, desire, and excess)
subchannels.synthesis: The test moves from the earth's surface into attention. What the eye follows determines whether adornment remains an object seen or becomes a force that displaces the chosen company.

subchannels.name: Wealth and Descendants Are Ranked Below What Remains
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wealth and children are classified as worldly adornment, while remaining sound deeds receive the better return and hope.
subchannels.active_motifs: accumulated wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; filial descent `ب ن ي:B007/m01`; displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; enduring remainder `ب ق ي:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; returning recompense `ث و ب:B002/m01`; expectant hope `ء م ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:46 (wealth, children, worldly adornment, remaining sound deeds, recompense, and hope)
subchannels.synthesis: The contrast does not deny the visible goods. It ranks them by transfer through time: adornment occupies the present, while sound action continues into return and expectation.

subchannels.name: A Father's Soundness Protects Benefit Across a Generation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A righteous father's prior state becomes a cause for preserving hidden wealth until his orphaned children reach maturity.
subchannels.active_motifs: paternal nurture `ء ب و:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; stored treasure `ك ن ز:B001/m01`; orphaned dependence `ي ت م:B001/m01`; arrival at maturity `ب ل غ:B001/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:82 (righteous father, orphaned children, hidden treasure, maturity, and mercy)
subchannels.synthesis: Soundness here survives its bearer as an inherited protection. Its durable effect is not a reputation but a timed arrangement that reaches dependents later.

subchannels.name: Sound Work Receives Return Across Rule and Final Lodging
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound action receives promised reward, just recompense, and prepared lodging from the opening proclamation through the final instruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; earned recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`; proportionate recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; guest provision and lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`; awaited encounter `ل ق ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:2, 18:30 (sound work and preserved reward); 18:88 (sound work and good recompense); 18:107 (sound work and prepared lodging); 18:110 (sound work directed toward encounter)
subchannels.synthesis: The repeated relation joins ethical quality to a return that can take several forms without changing its basis. Reward, ease, lodging, and encounter all answer the same durable orientation of action.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Displayed value is tested by whether it yields a durable good that survives attention, possession, generation, rule, and final reception.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), 4 (18:60-82), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: adornment repeatedly competes with sound action, while the same sound-action sense carries benefit beyond the visible object and sometimes beyond the original actor.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The whole-surah refrain gives durability a causal test: what is sound continues to benefit after beauty, wealth, and even the actor's lifetime cease to be present.

parent_channels.name: Following Is Judged by Its Object and Endpoint

subchannels.name: Following Desire Pulls Attention Beyond Its Chosen Company
subchannels.scene_or_process: A heedless heart follows inclination after the eyes and self are warned not to leave a devotional company.
subchannels.active_motifs: following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; desire's inclination `ه و ي:B004/m01`; lapse from alertness `غ ف ل:B001/m01`; directed eye `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; excess beyond measure `ف ر ط:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:28 (heedlessness, following desire, displaced gaze, and excessive affair)
subchannels.synthesis: Desire leads by continually redrawing the boundary of attention. Its endpoint is not a discovered place but a relation already judged excessive.

subchannels.name: Following an Informed Guide Requires Deferred Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A learner requests to follow for sound knowledge and must suspend questions until the guide supplies the explanatory frame.
subchannels.active_motifs: following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; encompassing knowledge `ح و ط:B004/m01`; inner acquaintance `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; directed question `س ء ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:66-70 (request to follow, taught guidance, patience, incomplete knowledge, and deferred questions)
subchannels.synthesis: This following relation is productive because it accepts an epistemic asymmetry. The learner's endpoint cannot be reached by reacting to each partial scene as if it were complete.

subchannels.name: Following a Means Converts Connection into Reach
subchannels.scene_or_process: A supplied connection is followed repeatedly until western, eastern, and intermontane limits are reached.
subchannels.active_motifs: following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; rope-like connection `س ب ب:B003/m01`; arrival at an endpoint `ب ل غ:B001/m01`; interval between sides `ب ي ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:85-86 (following a means to the western limit); 18:89-90 (following to the eastern limit); 18:92-93 (following to the interval between barriers)
subchannels.synthesis: The means does not lead through persuasion or authority. It offers a connection whose endpoint appears only through disciplined continuation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Following has no fixed moral value by itself; its direction is determined by what leads and by the endpoint the relation makes reachable.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 2 (18:27-44), 4 (18:60-82), and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: the same following operation moves from desire, to an informed guide, to connective means repeatedly pursued to spatial limits.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Desire, teacher, and route are placed in the same grammatical role so that the object of following becomes the decisive variable.

parent_channels.name: Companionship Exposes the Terms of Remaining Together

subchannels.name: The Cave Companions Become a Collective Through Shared Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: The companions are named as one group and then act through a shared faith, stabilized heart, withdrawal, and refuge.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`; sheltering cave `ك ه ف:B002/m01`; heart-binding `ر ب ط:B004/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:9-10 (companions of the cave, refuge, and sought guidance); 18:13-16 (shared faith, bound hearts, withdrawal, and refuge)
subchannels.synthesis: Their companionship is constituted by coordinated orientation and movement. The cave shelters a collective already formed through a common refusal and destination.

subchannels.name: A Garden Companion Preserves the Relation by Contradicting Pride
subchannels.scene_or_process: The wealthier speaker uses companionship as an audience for superiority, while the companion answers with a corrective account of creation and dependence.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; boastful superiority by quantity `ك ث ر:B002/m01`; accumulated wealth `م و ل:B001/m01`; social dominance `ع ز ز:B002/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:34 (boast addressed to the companion); 18:37 (the companion's corrective response)
subchannels.synthesis: Remaining a companion does not require confirming the owner's self-estimate. Truthful contradiction becomes the ethical work performed by the relation.

subchannels.name: Learning Companionship Ends When Its Patience Contract Fails
subchannels.scene_or_process: The learner accepts that further questioning will terminate companionship, and the third breach produces explicit separation and interpretation.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship `ص ح ب:B001/m01`; self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; directed question `س ء ل:B001/m01`; separation into parts `ف ر ق:B002/m01`; disclosed outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:67 (predicted impatience); 18:76 (companionship made conditional on no further question); 18:78 (separation and interpretation)
subchannels.synthesis: The relation has a declared procedural limit. Once that limit is reached, explanation can still be given, but companionship no longer supplies its setting.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Companionship is sustained by a shared orientation or truthful correction and ends when the relation's declared epistemic terms can no longer be kept.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), and 4 (18:60-82); bridge: the companion role progresses from aligned collective identity, through corrective dialogue, to a conditional learning relation that terminates after repeated breach.
