parent_channels.surprising_reach: A companion is not defined merely by proximity; each scene tests what the proximity is for.

parent_channels.name: Substitution Is Judged by Authority and Outcome

subchannels.name: No Substitute Can Occupy the Place of Divine Words
subchannels.scene_or_process: The revealed book is to be recited because no agent can install a replacement for its words.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; individuated words `ك ل م:B002/m01`; received revelation `و ح ي:B004/m01`; written book `ك ت ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:27 (revealed book and no substitute for divine words)
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution is excluded because the relevant authority and equivalence do not exist. The addressee's task is transmission, not replacement.

subchannels.name: False Allies Are an Evil Substitute for Proper Protection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Satan and his descendants are adopted as allies in place of the proper protector despite being enemies.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; adopted dependence `ء خ ذ:B010/m01`; chosen ally `و ل ي:B004/m01`; adversarial relation `ع د و:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:50 (enemies adopted as allies and condemned as an evil substitute)
subchannels.synthesis: This substitution is possible as a human choice but fails functionally. What takes the protector's place is incapable of carrying the protector's role.

subchannels.name: Divine Replacement Improves Purity and Kinship
subchannels.scene_or_process: A removed child is replaced by one expected to be better in purity and nearer in tenderness.
subchannels.active_motifs: substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; comparative good `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; kinship-nearness `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; womb-tenderness `ر ح م:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:81 (divinely intended replacement, greater purity, and nearer tenderness)
subchannels.synthesis: The replacement is evaluated by the relation it makes possible. Authority and outcome distinguish this act from both textual alteration and misdirected allegiance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Replacement is legitimate only when the replacing authority can preserve or improve the relevant order; otherwise substitution is impossible or corrupt.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), and 4 (18:60-82); bridge: one substitution sense is successively denied to divine words, condemned in false allegiance, and enacted as a purer replacement in a vulnerable family.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same operation moves from impossibility, through moral failure, to mercy without losing its core sense of one thing standing in another's place.

parent_channels.name: Supposition Is Defeated by Exhaustive Accounting

subchannels.name: Visible Appearance Misstates Wonder and Wakefulness
subchannels.scene_or_process: The cave account is initially liable to a mistaken estimate of comparative wonder, and the sleepers' visible bodies invite a false judgment of wakefulness.
subchannels.active_motifs: supposition `ح س ب:B002/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; inscribed record `ر ق م:B001/m01`; sleeping stillness `ر ق د:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:9 (misestimated wonder of the cave and inscription); 18:18 (sleepers supposed awake)
subchannels.synthesis: Appearance supplies enough evidence for a guess but not for a correct classification. The scene must be narrated from outside the observer's immediate sight.

subchannels.name: Possession, Allegiance, and Craft Generate False Self-Estimates
subchannels.scene_or_process: A garden owner predicts permanence, false allies are assumed usable, and lost workers suppose their production excellent.
subchannels.active_motifs: unsupported conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; imagined permanence `ء ب د:B001/m01`; supposition `ح س ب:B002/m01`; adopted dependence `ء خ ذ:B010/m01`; chosen ally `و ل ي:B004/m01`; skilled craft `ص ن ع:B002/m01`; lost course `ض ل ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:35-36 (garden permanence and return estimated from possession); 18:102 (allies presumed viable); 18:104 (lost labor supposed well made)
subchannels.synthesis: Each estimate treats present control as evidence of future or final value. Disclosure separates confidence in the work or support from its actual standing.

subchannels.name: Exhaustive Count Converts Hidden Duration and Deed into Evidence
subchannels.scene_or_process: The cave interval and the moral record are both subjected to a count that reaches the furthest term and omits no scale of action.
subchannels.active_motifs: exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`; temporal endpoint `ء م د:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:11-12 (numbered years and exhaustive comparison of duration); 18:49 (written record, small and large acts counted and present)
subchannels.synthesis: Count corrects supposition by turning what was inaccessible into a complete object. Hidden time becomes a bounded interval, and dispersed deeds become a present record.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Surface-based estimation misclassifies scale, state, durability, and value, whereas exhaustive count or final disclosure fixes what the object actually is.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: repeated supposition scenes are answered by complete enumeration of hidden duration and deed.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The contrast joins visual illusion, economic confidence, false allegiance, and skilled labor under one epistemic failure.

parent_channels.name: A Fixed Promise Ends Temporary Arrangements

subchannels.name: The Awakened Cave Makes the Promise Publicly Certain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discovery of the sleepers converts their hidden preservation into evidence that resurrection and the divine promise are true.
subchannels.active_motifs: declared promise `و ع د:B001/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:21 (discovery, knowledge, true promise, and certainty of the Hour)
subchannels.synthesis: The promise is not presented only as a future assertion. A completed temporary arrangement becomes its public proof.

subchannels.name: Asserted Permanence Is Distinguished from Granted Abiding
subchannels.scene_or_process: The garden owner's forecast that his possession will never perish is set against promised reward and final lodging whose abiding does not depend on possession.
subchannels.active_motifs: imagined permanence `ء ب د:B001/m01`; unsupported conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; abiding residence `خ ل د:B001/m01`; guest provision and lodging `ن ز ل:B005/m01`; change of place or state `ح و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:3 (promised abiding reward); 18:35-36 (garden and return assigned permanence by conjecture); 18:107-108 (abiding lodging with no desired transfer)
subchannels.synthesis: Duration is not established by confidence or enclosure. True abiding is received as an outcome, while asserted permanence collapses with the object that was expected to guarantee it.

subchannels.name: Accountability Waits at an Appointment Without Disappearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Final presentation, individual delay, and communal destruction are all assigned times that hold consequence back without cancelling it.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed promise `و ع د:B003/m01`; aligned presentation `ص ف ف:B001/m01`; protective forgiveness `غ ف ر:B002/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; settled community `ق ر ي:B001/m01`; destructive ending `ه ل ك:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:48 (presentation according to the promised appointment); 18:58 (merciful delay to an appointed time); 18:59 (towns destroyed at an appointment)
subchannels.synthesis: Appointment organizes both patience and certainty. The interval can be merciful, but it cannot be treated as evidence that the endpoint has ceased to exist.

subchannels.name: The Protective Rampart Ends When the Promise Arrives
subchannels.scene_or_process: A barrier that successfully controls passage is leveled when the promised boundary reaches it.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed promise `و ع د:B003/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B001/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`; crushing levelness `د ك ك:B001/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:95-98 (constructed rampart, merciful protection, promised arrival, and leveling)
subchannels.synthesis: Material success does not confer permanence. The promise defines the barrier's service life and the point at which its protective role must yield.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Concealment, delay, material protection, and claims of permanence remain subordinate to a divinely fixed temporal boundary.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: appointed promise repeatedly terminates a provisional state, while false and true permanence are separated by whether that boundary is divinely grounded.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sleep, a garden, delayed punishment, a rampart, and final lodging are all evaluated by who controls their duration.

parent_channels.name: Solar Boundaries Calibrate Exposure

subchannels.name: The Cave Routes Solar Passage Around Vulnerable Bodies
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rising and setting light is diverted across the cave's sides while the sleepers remain in its broad opening.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; sheltering cave `ك ه ف:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:17 (sunrise, sunset, routed passage, and cave shelter)
subchannels.synthesis: Solar movement is compatible with protection because its contact is spatially managed. Exposure is neither total nor absent.

subchannels.name: Solar Endpoints Reveal Different Conditions of Rule
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reaching the setting and rising places of the sun exposes distinct populations, including an eastern people without covering from it.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; spring source `ع ي ن:B006/m01`; dark mud `ح م ء:B001/m01`; protective covering `س ت ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:86 (western setting at the spring and encountered people); 18:90 (eastern rising upon a people without covering)
subchannels.synthesis: The same celestial movement that is routed around the sleepers becomes a geographic measure of sovereign reach. Rule begins with reading how bodies are exposed at each limit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sunrise and sunset define exposure conditions that are actively routed or governed rather than treated as neutral scenery.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: identical rising and setting anchors first map protection around the cave and later organize encounters with peoples at the western and eastern limits.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sun links private refuge to public rule by making exposure a condition that calls for calibrated response.

parent_channels.name: Fire Reverses from Punitive Enclosure to Protective Fabrication

subchannels.name: Punitive Fire Encloses and Removes Diversion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire first surrounds its occupants and later appears to the guilty as an unavoidable destination with no route away.
subchannels.active_motifs: burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; physical encirclement `ح و ط:B001/m01`; surrounding pavilion `س ر د ق:B001/m01`; visual recognition `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; unsupported conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; route of diversion `ص ر ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:29 (fire as encircling pavilion); 18:53 (fire seen, falling expected, and no diversion)
subchannels.synthesis: The fire's punitive force lies in convergence of approach and enclosure. It is both what surrounds and what can no longer be avoided.

subchannels.name: Controlled Fire Fuses a Defensive Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: Blowing turns aligned iron masses into fire before molten copper is poured over them to close a breach.
subchannels.active_motifs: burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; forceful blowing `ن ف خ:B001/m01`; iron masses `ز ب ر:B002/m01`; iron material `ح د د:B004/m01`; molten pouring `ف ر غ:B002/m01`; molten copper `ق ط ر:B006/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:95-96 (rampart request, aligned iron, blowing, fire, and poured copper)
subchannels.synthesis: Here heat is bounded by technique and purpose. Instead of consuming occupants, it changes separate materials into a surface that protects them.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Burning heat takes its moral function from the process it serves, either trapping and receiving the condemned or transforming material into protection.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: the same active fire sense moves from enclosing destination to seen inevitability and then to a controlled fabrication stage.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire is not assigned one fixed polarity; disciplined use reverses its role without weakening its force.

parent_channels.name: Convergence Reorganizes Separate Parts

subchannels.name: A Junction of Waters Becomes the Sought Threshold
subchannels.scene_or_process: The traveler seeks and reaches the meeting place of two seas, where the missed sign redirects the journey.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining scattered parts `ج م ع:B001/m01`; gathered meeting place `ج م ع:B002/m01`; open water `ب ح ر:B001/m01`; arrival at an endpoint `ب ل غ:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:60-61 (the sought meeting place of the two seas and arrival there)
subchannels.synthesis: Convergence first defines a location. The meeting point matters because it concentrates otherwise separate routes and makes the hidden turn of the journey recoverable.

subchannels.name: Alignment and Heat Integrate Construction Masses
subchannels.scene_or_process: Iron blocks are brought together, equalized between mountain sides, heated, and overlaid until they function as one rampart.
subchannels.active_motifs: iron masses `ز ب ر:B002/m01`; aligned faces `س و ي:B001/m01`; mountain side `ص د ف:B003/m01`; forceful blowing `ن ف خ:B001/m01`; molten pouring `ف ر غ:B002/m01`; molten copper `ق ط ر:B006/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:95-96 (iron masses, alignment, blowing, and poured metal)
subchannels.synthesis: The parts are not merely piled. Alignment and phase change remove the routes through which the assembled mass could still behave as separate pieces.

subchannels.name: Turbulent Parts Become a Complete Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: Released groups surge through one another until a horn blast gathers them as one totality.
subchannels.active_motifs: distributed parts `ب ع ض:B001/m01`; wave-like interpenetration `م و ج:B001/m01`; forceful blowing `ن ف خ:B001/m01`; summoning horn `ص و ر:B004/m01`; joining scattered parts `ج م ع:B001/m01`; complete assembly `ج م ع:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:99 (parts surging, horn blown, and total gathering)
subchannels.synthesis: Uncontrolled contact does not itself create order. Directed blowing supplies the transition from turbulent mixture to complete assembly.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Separate masses become a new functional whole when they are brought to a junction, aligned and fused, or gathered after uncontrolled interpenetration.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 4 (18:60-82), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: a repeated convergence signature progresses from natural meeting place, through engineered integration, to total assembly.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sequence scales one operation from waters, to construction materials, to humanity without merging their distinct outcomes.

parent_channels.name: Authoritative Text Moves from Guidance to Evidence

subchannels.name: The Descended Book Is Straightened to Direct Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written revelation descends without semantic crookedness and is made upright for warning, promise, and action.
subchannels.active_motifs: organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; revelatory descent `ن ز ل:B002/m01`; semantic deviation `ع و ج:B002/m01`; upright equilibrium `ق و م:B008/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:1-2 (descended book, no crookedness, upright direction, warning, and promise)
subchannels.synthesis: The book begins as an active standard addressed to readers. Its form is aligned so that the conduct it calls for is not distorted at the source.

subchannels.name: The Revealed Book Admits Recitation but Not Replacement
subchannels.scene_or_process: The reader is commanded to carry the book forward while being denied authority to substitute for its words.
subchannels.active_motifs: organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; sequential recitation `ت ل و:B001/m01`; received revelation `و ح ي:B004/m01`; substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; individuated words `ك ل م:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:27 (revealed book, recitation, and no substitute for its words)
subchannels.synthesis: Transmission and alteration are separated. The book can enter new acts of recitation without becoming available for replacement.

subchannels.name: The Placed Book Converts Conduct into Fixed Evidence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written record is set before its subjects and makes every small and large action present.
subchannels.active_motifs: placement in view `و ض ع:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; fixed record `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:49 (book placed, exhaustive inclusion, and deeds found present)
subchannels.synthesis: The book's final role is evidentiary rather than directive. What readers did in relation to guidance is reorganized into an object that can no longer be revised by its subjects.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The written book first directs conduct, then stands beyond human replacement, and finally appears as the fixed evidence of conduct.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), and 3 (18:45-59); bridge: the same organized-writing sense changes role from address, to unalterable standard, to placed record.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reader and record exchange positions: people first stand before the book's guidance, then their own actions stand present in a book.

parent_channels.name: Authoritative Report Reclassifies the Seen

subchannels.name: The Cave Account Is Reported in Truth
subchannels.scene_or_process: The youths' externally puzzling state is replaced by an ordered report explicitly aligned with truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: delivered report `ن ب ء:B002/m01`; sequential narration `ق ص ص:B002/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:13 (their report narrated in truth)
subchannels.synthesis: The report does not merely add detail. It determines which interpretation of the visible traces can count as the account.

subchannels.name: Interpretation Reports the Outcome Hidden from the Learner
subchannels.scene_or_process: Limited acquaintance with the events gives way to an initiated report that returns each act to its concealed outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: delivered report `ن ب ء:B002/m01`; encompassing knowledge `ح و ط:B004/m01`; inner acquaintance `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; disclosed outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:68 (the learner lacks encompassing acquaintance); 18:78, 18:82 (initiated report and completed interpretation)
subchannels.synthesis: Observation remains valid but incomplete. The report reclassifies damage, removal, and repair by supplying relations unavailable at the moment of sight.

subchannels.name: The Final Report Identifies Lost Work Beneath Good Craft
subchannels.scene_or_process: A question offers to report the greatest losers, then discloses that apparently excellent craft can arrive without value.
subchannels.active_motifs: delivered report `ن ب ء:B002/m01`; diminishing loss `خ س ر:B001/m01`; lost course `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; supposition `ح س ب:B002/m01`; skilled craft `ص ن ع:B002/m01`; accounting scale `و ز ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:103-105 (report of the greatest losers, supposed good craft, and absence of weight)
subchannels.synthesis: The report overturns self-description. Skilled production is visible to its makers, but its final category depends on a frame they do not control.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A warranted report supplies the causal or evaluative frame that direct observation cannot establish by itself.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 4 (18:60-82), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: the same delivered-news sense introduces the cave's true account, the guide's interpretation, and the final identification of lost workers.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Report repeatedly arrives after a scene has already invited a weaker interpretation.

parent_channels.name: Partnership Fails Governance, Response, and Worship

subchannels.name: Governance Admits No Participating Protector
subchannels.scene_or_process: Divine judgment excludes every participant, and the collapse of private wealth reveals where true governing protection resides.
subchannels.active_motifs: claimed participation `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; idolatrous association `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; judgment and rule `ح ك م:B002/m01`; governing support `و ل ي:B003/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:26 (no participant in divine judgment and no protector besides God); 18:44 (governing protection belongs to God in truth)
subchannels.synthesis: The first failed role is authority. A partner cannot acquire a share merely by being treated as one, and material control cannot manufacture that share.

subchannels.name: Regretted and Summoned Partners Cannot Answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: The garden owner regrets association after collapse, while formally summoned partners fail to answer across a barrier.
subchannels.active_motifs: claimed participation `ش ر ك:B001/m01`; idolatrous association `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; summons `د ع و:B001/m01`; responsive answer `ج و ب:B003/m01`; obstructing barrier `و ب ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:42 (regret for association); 18:52 (partners summoned, no answer, and barrier)
subchannels.synthesis: The partner claim is subjected to a communication test. Regret recognizes the failed relation internally, and the unanswered summons demonstrates it publicly.

subchannels.name: Adopted Allies Yield to Undivided Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: Created servants and an enemy are adopted as allies, but the closing instruction removes every associate from worship.
subchannels.active_motifs: adopted dependence `ء خ ذ:B010/m01`; chosen ally `و ل ي:B004/m01`; devoted service `ع ب د:B003/m01`; adversarial relation `ع د و:B003/m01`; idolatrous association `ش ر ك:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:50 (enemy adopted as ally); 18:102 (servants adopted as allies); 18:110 (no association in worship)
subchannels.synthesis: The final correction is not an improved substitute alliance. It is undivided service that refuses to assign the protective or devotional role elsewhere.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claimed participation with God is tested at three functional sites and fails to share rule, answer a summons, or receive undivided service.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 3 (18:45-59), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: partnership language progresses from denied authority, through regret and failed response, to explicit exclusion from worship.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Association is not refuted only as an idea; every role assigned to the partner is made to fail in operation.

parent_channels.name: Purity Moves from Selection to Judgment to Replacement

subchannels.name: Purity Directs the Choice of Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: The buyer must inspect the city and select food with the purest or best outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; discriminating inspection `ن ظ ر:B001/m01`; food and eating `ط ع م:B001/m01`; bringing back `ء ت ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:19 (inspection for the purest food and return with provision)
subchannels.synthesis: Purity first functions prospectively. It directs selection toward a provision whose permissibility and consequence are both favorable.

subchannels.name: Apparent Purity Grounds the Protest Against Killing
subchannels.scene_or_process: The killed youth is classified as a pure person without a compensating crime, making the act appear morally impossible.
subchannels.active_motifs: purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; inviolable person `ن ف س:B011/m01`; lethal removal `ق ت ل:B001/m01`; severe strangeness `ن ك ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:74 (pure person, killing without another life, and protested enormity)
subchannels.synthesis: The learner applies purity to the visible moral status of the present person. Within that frame, no justifying relation is available.

subchannels.name: Replacement Is Evaluated by Greater Purity and Nearness
subchannels.scene_or_process: The explanation shifts from present appearance to future relation and names the replacement as better in purity and nearer in tenderness.
subchannels.active_motifs: purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; substitution `ب د ل:B001/m01`; comparative good `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; kinship-nearness `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; womb-tenderness `ر ح م:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:80-81 (anticipated overwhelming and replacement with one better in purity and tenderness)
subchannels.synthesis: Purity is not discarded but relocated into a causal horizon unavailable at the protest. The criterion remains stable while the object and timescale of evaluation change.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Purity is an outcome-bearing criterion that first guides a choice, then becomes the object of moral protest, and finally evaluates a replacement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 4 (18:60-82); bridge: one purity sense recurs in the selected food, the slain youth's apparent innocence, and the promised child's better outcome.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: An ordinary procurement criterion becomes the lexical hinge of the most difficult moral scene.

parent_channels.name: Limited Understanding Has Opposite Outcomes

subchannels.name: Covered Reception Prevents Understanding and Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Turning and neglect produce heart covers and ear weight so that reminder cannot become understood guidance.
subchannels.active_motifs: penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`; enclosing cover `ك ن ن:B001/m01`; blocking weight `و ق ر:B001/m01`; received reminder `ذ ك ر:B009/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:57 (covered hearts, weighted ears, failed understanding, and failed guidance)
subchannels.synthesis: The limitation is internally reinforced. More address cannot compensate because the channels required to process it are themselves the objects of closure.

subchannels.name: Scarce Shared Speech Is Bridged by Cooperative Construction
subchannels.scene_or_process: A people who scarcely understand speech nevertheless communicate a threat and join a ruler in closing the exposed interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: penetrative understanding `ف ق ه:B001/m01`; gap-closing barrier `س د د:B001/m01`; cooperative aid `ع و ن:B001/m01`; bundled strength `ق و ي:B001/m01`; breach-filling construction `ر د م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:93-96 (scarce understanding, communicated request, cooperative strength, and rampart construction)
subchannels.synthesis: Comprehension remains limited, but action does not stop. A concrete problem, a bounded request, and shared labor create a practical translation layer.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Restricted comprehension can harden into permanent exclusion or be overcome through communicative adaptation and cooperative work.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; pericopes spanned: 3 (18:45-59) and 5 (18:83-98); bridge: the same understanding sense is negated in both scenes, but only the second develops a practical channel around the limitation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Minimal shared speech can support protection where abundant reminder fails against willful closure.

parent_channels.name: Compensation Shifts from Wage to Consequence

subchannels.name: Good Work Has a Reward That Is Not Lost
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound action is promised a good return, and the later statement explicitly denies that excellent work can be made to disappear.
subchannels.active_motifs: earned recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; beneficial excellence `ح س ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:2 (good work and good reward); 18:30 (reward of excellent work not lost)
subchannels.synthesis: Compensation is detached from immediate social payment. Its preservation belongs to the evaluator who knows the work's actual quality.

subchannels.name: Repair Is Performed Where Food Is Refused and Wage Is Available
subchannels.scene_or_process: A town refuses to feed the travelers, yet its collapsing wall is repaired even though the repairer could have taken a wage.
subchannels.active_motifs: requested food `ط ع م:B002/m01`; earned recompense or wage `ء ج ر:B001/m01`; raised wall `ج د ر:B001/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:77 (refused food, repaired wall, and possible wage); 18:82 (the repair disclosed as mercy)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene breaks reciprocity between beneficiary and worker. The repair's purpose lies with absent orphans and future maturity, not with compensation from the inhospitable town.

subchannels.name: Recompense Answers Action Under Rule and Final Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler assigns good recompense to sound action, while final recompense answers rejection and mockery.
subchannels.active_motifs: proportionate recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; concealment of truth `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; derisive treatment `ه ز ء:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 18:88 (sound action and good recompense); 18:106 (final recompense for rejection and mockery)
subchannels.synthesis: Compensation becomes public consequence. Its polarity changes with the act, while the relation between action and return remains stable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The return on action may appear as promised reward, negotiable wage, or proportionate consequence, but it remains tied to the action's actual function rather than immediate recognition.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26), 2 (18:27-44), 4 (18:60-82), 5 (18:83-98), and 6 (18:99-110); bridge: recompense language progresses from guaranteed reward, through a repair for which wages could be taken, to governing and final consequence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The unpaid wall repair separates the worth of an act from whether its nearest beneficiaries recognize or finance it.

parent_channels.name: S1. Provisioning Under Concealment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After awakening, the group converts stored money into a cautious urban procurement mission whose food and information risks must both be managed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: coined silver `و ر ق:B002/m01`; city `م د ن:B001/m01`; discriminating inspection `ن ظ ر:B001/m01`; purity and good outcome `ز ك و:B002/m01`; food and eating `ط ع م:B001/m01`; bringing back `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; allotted provision `ر ز ق:B001/m01`; gentle handling `ل ط ف:B001/m01`; subtle hidden movement `ل ط ف:B002/m01`; fine awareness `ش ع ر:B005/m01`; exhaustive exclusion of anyone `ء ح د:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:19 (silver sent into the city, inspection for pure food, return with provision, gentleness, and concealment from everyone)
parent_channels.synthesis: Provision is obtained through a tightly coupled protocol: inspect quality, transact with portable value, return with food, and minimize the informational trace of the transaction.

parent_channels.name: S2. Disciplined Gaze and Company
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The self and eyes are restrained toward a worshipping company, while worldly adornment, heedlessness, and excessive desire pull attention across that boundary.
parent_channels.active_motifs: self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; personal self `ن ف س:B012/m01`; inner intention `ن ف س:B013/m01`; devotional calling `د ع و:B001/m01`; morning approach `غ د و:B001/m01`; evening return `ع ش و:B004/m01`; sought face `و ج ه:B001/m01`; boundary transgression `ع د و:B001/m01`; directed eye `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; near worldly life `د ن و:B002/m01`; obedience `ط و ع:B001/m01`; lapse from alertness `غ ف ل:B001/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; recovered reminder `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; desire's inclination `ه و ي:B004/m01`; excess beyond measure `ف ر ط:B004/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:28 (restraining the self with morning and evening callers, fixing the eyes, resisting worldly adornment, and refusing heedless excess)
parent_channels.synthesis: Attention is treated as a governed movement. Stable company requires holding both the self and gaze in place against an attractive field whose pull would reorganize allegiance.

parent_channels.name: S3. Contract of Deferred Interpretation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A learner requests access to sound knowledge but must accept that questions will be withheld until the informed guide initiates explanation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: disciplined following `ت ب ع:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; self-restraint `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; operative capacity `ط و ع:B003/m01`; encompassing knowledge `ح و ط:B004/m01`; inner acquaintance `خ ب ر:B001/m01`; directed question `س ء ل:B001/m01`; narrated report `ح د ث:B003/m01`; recovered reminder `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; disclosed outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:66-70 (request to follow, taught guidance, predicted impatience, and the ban on questions until explanation); 18:78 (separation and promised interpretation); 18:82 (final interpretation and denial of autonomous action)
parent_channels.synthesis: The agreement sequences evidence and explanation instead of suppressing inquiry absolutely. Patience is the capacity to let an incomplete scene remain unresolved until hidden relations can be disclosed.

parent_channels.name: S4. Turbulent Parts Gathered Whole
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Released groups interpenetrate like waves until a horn blast converts turbulent parts into one complete assembly.
parent_channels.active_motifs: release from restraint `ت ر ك:B001/m01`; distributed parts `ب ع ض:B001/m01`; wave-like interpenetration `م و ج:B001/m01`; forceful blowing `ن ف خ:B001/m01`; summoning horn `ص و ر:B004/m01`; unifying the scattered `ج م ع:B001/m01`; complete assembly `ج م ع:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:99 (some released to surge through others, the horn blown, and all gathered together)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene moves from uncontrolled mixture to total collection. The same multitude first lacks boundaries among its parts and then receives a single imposed form.

parent_channels.name: S5. Finite Ink and Inexhaustible Words
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The sea is recast as an ink reservoir whose depletion, even under replacement, cannot exhaust divine words.
parent_channels.active_motifs: open sea `ب ح ر:B001/m01`; ink-feeding reservoir `م د د:B005/m01`; connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; individuated words `ك ل م:B002/m01`; complete exhaustion `ن ف د:B001/m01`; replacement brought forward `ق ب ل:B002/m01`; equivalent likeness `م ث ل:B001/m01`; connected replenishment `م د د:B002/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:109 (the sea as ink, its exhaustion before the words, and another equal sea supplied)
parent_channels.synthesis: A vast visible medium is used to measure expression and then shown to be finite. Adding an equivalent reservoir enlarges quantity without changing the asymmetry between material inscription and what is to be expressed.

parent_channels.name: S6. Human Likeness and Undivided Service
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The messenger marks bodily likeness while distinguishing revelatory reception, then directs hope of encounter into sound action without divided worship.
parent_channels.active_motifs: human embodiment `ب ش ر:B002/m01`; shared likeness `م ث ل:B001/m01`; received revelation `و ح ي:B004/m01`; indivisible oneness `و ح د:B004/m01`; expectant hope `ر ج و:B001/m01`; awaited encounter `ل ق ي:B004/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; restorative goodness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; idolatrous association `ش ر ك:B002/m01`; devoted service `ع ب د:B003/m01`; sole deity `ء ل ه:B001/m01`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 18:110 (human likeness, revelation of one God, hope for encounter, sound action, and refusal to associate anyone in worship)
parent_channels.synthesis: The closing instruction holds similarity and asymmetry together. Shared humanity prevents elevation of the messenger, while revelation supplies the basis for an undivided orientation of action and service.
